reviews.x: I was looking for a manicure device for natural nails. According to other reviewers, this doesn’t work well on acrylic or gel, which I’ve never used, so I thought I would give it a try on my natural nails. It was a good decision! It was also a good price, which was helpful since I have never used one and only heard of  “nail drills” when I searched for emery boards. I couldn’t figure out who would want to drill their nails! It sounded like a torture device! It turned out to be easy and painless.

I work in a hospital and can not wear nails or gel.  My previous nail drill lasted over 20 years.  The quality of the unit itself is made of a lightweight sturdy metal in a cute pink.  It is easy to handle whether manicure or pedicure and the reverse rotation allowed me to easily go from right to left.  Something my old drill didn't have along with different speeds. The fantastic part of this is the interchangeable (7 in 1) kit.  They are more flush to the head so there is no breaking of the rol

This is a decent nail drill. It’s easy to use and comes with a lot of attachments, it saves me time. This is also my second product from miropure and I could say they make good and quality products. I charged it for the first time and it took less than 5 hrs. to charge it.
Brought it for my girlfriend. She loves it. It has all the attachments that she needs. Travel size. Rechargable. Well packaged.
Bought it for my daughter who likes the product. She states it does the job and likes that it's rechargeable.

Works well considering the price. It powers off after an amoit of time has passed wich can get annoying. I eoild also have liked some heavier grit attachments most of them feel more for polishing when i need them for grinding.  The charging pory was hard to find and it's odd it a USB. Over all I'm very happy with this product.
I USE IT ON MY TOE NAILS AND IT HELPS AND IT IS EASY

reviews.t: It works and has a good assortment
reviews.x: I purchased this for my daughter.  I personally know very little about nails. She was very happy to receive it.  She said it had all of the attachments she needed.  She did comment that it was not as powerful as her old one and slightly louder.  It did work well for her though and I would buy it again for the price.

reviews.t: Great size, Easy use, Super convenient...
reviews.x: My only complaint is that the dust mask on the cone-shaped grinder limits my ability to reach certain angles of my (toe) nails. And unfortunately it's not detachable. Other than that, its a really great and simple tool!
Even better than described; literally has everything one could possibly need (and more!) To give yourself salon quality nail treatments. Definitely recommend

reviews.t: I think it's better for regular nails
reviews.x: I think this rechargeable drill works good for regular nails but for acrylic nails the sand pieces gets dull really fast. And it doesn't stay charged long.

reviews.t: Very easy to get a great manicure at home.
reviews.x: I was invited to review a product of my choice, at no cost.  I was not asked to give a positive review, and if it wasn't good I wouldn't say it was. That being said, I really like it a lot.  Of the choices I was given, I chose this nail drill because I have been having problems with my nails.  The biggest problem I have is that when I had acrylic nails I would get a fill for $20.  After I removed the acrylic nails I was charged $18 for a regular manicure and it seemed they did a sloppy job.  I t

The quality of the MiroPure Rechargeable 7-in-1 Manicure and Pedicure Kit is better than I initially anticipated for the cost. Device charged quickly, I was able to shape and buff nails with ease. My only complaint is that specific instructions for how to actually use each attachment are not included in the Owners Manual; just the intended function of the separate attachments. I would like to use the Carborundum Grinder to remove my cuticles but I'm a little intimidated and feel I need to watch

I just got this today and couldn’t wait to try it. I only charged it a short time.  I was very skeptical about buying one that’s so inexpensive. My nails were badly damaged somehow and had deep ridges and bumps on the surface. I really wasn’t expecting it to do much. Wow was I wrong! My nails aren’t perfect buy they’re so much better and whiter than they ever are! It seems pretty well built and durable. I love that it’s lightweight and portable. You definitely can’t beat the cost. Don’t hesitate

reviews.t: Nice nail drill for the price.
reviews.x: I have had this since the middle of March and used it about 3 times now. I really like this nail drill and I think it is a really great option if you are not trying to spend a ton of money, It does get the job done but it takes a long time. It doesn't have a lot of power which is to be expected with a $12 drill. With that being said... for it being ONLY $12 it honestly is a nice tool and does work. You just need to be patient and take a little extra time with it.

reviews.t: Don't let this little treasure fool you!
reviews.x: I am so pleased with my MiroPure manicure pedicure kit!  I have very hard nails.  Hard enough that I have to use toe nail clippers on my fingers, then file and file to smooth them out.  I decided to give this MicrPure a try, it was priced very reasonably so I wouldn't be out much.  Believe me it worked like a charm!!  Give it a try I'm sure you'll love it too.  Also, it's small enough you can slip into you purse or bag.

This is rechargeable & reasonably priced, a big plus.  It is also an attractive appliance.  But he attachments take a very long time to have any effect, & some aren't shaped well for the function, so they don't really work. As an amateur, I don't know why dual direction is needed & the faster speed didn't increase effectiveness.

Love the idea that I can just recharge the machine and not having to worry about batteries. -The machine works just as expected the coarse file is really powerful. -I do recommend this product even do it took a long time to make my nails shine.  I would give it 5 starts but it does take a long time to get my nails to shine.

It works great, my only critique is the different drills; I wish there were smaller and fit around my fingertips better. Also, only a little ignorant tidbit of mine, starting it confused me a bit, but I managed to figure it out. It's a good inexpensive buy if you're desperate for a nail drill.

I don’t have a lot of experience with a nail drill so I will say what I like about the product.  It has multiple attachment heads with extra pads for each.  It’s rechargeable so no batteries to replace and it’s compact which makes it portable.  Great price.  No complaints to speak of.

I love this thing. It was already charged when I received it so it only took about an hour to full charge it. I was able to easily assemble it and use all the drills. I ended up with a nice manicured look. This will be great for when I am on the go and can't get to a salon.

Product worked great for a few months then it started not turning on and stopping during using.  Fully charged.  It appears to have a short.  Comes with a one year warranty, but the email given isn't valid.  Going to have to buy something else now.

reviews.t: Not the best for acrylic or gel polish
reviews.x: The nail drill is really good for natural or press on nails. It's decent for acrylic nails too if you have time bb ut for gel it's nearly useless. I wish I would've known but it is still a decent drill

reviews.t: Easy to Use and good value
reviews.x: I liked the price but this one is sturdy enough for personal use. My toenails and calluses need regular grinding for best treatment and this is easy to use to target the nails and the spots on my feet.
Had some issues with registration of my warranty.  The agent that I contacted couldn't have been more helpful.  She was quick to handle my problem and corrected it immediately.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the device as easy to use and convenient.
Many reviewers say it offers good value for the price and works well considering the cost.
Several reviewers praise the included attachments and assortment of accessories.
Some reviewers note it is not very powerful, works better on natural nails than acrylic, and can be slow or lose charge.
A few reviewers mention minor drawbacks such as the device powering off automatically, hard-to-find charging port, non-detachable dust guard, and missing usage instructions.
